newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan stocks end slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan stocks end slightly higher.

text.p: The Casablanca stock exchange closed on Wednesday 0.09 percent higher, lifted by Banque Commerciale du Maroc and credit firms, stockbrokers said.
The bourse all-share index closed at 648.11, up from 647.50 points on Tuesday.
Blue-chip Banque Commerciale du Maroc was up 23 dirhams to 903 dirhams.
Credit firms, Credor rose 11 dirhams to 745 dirhams and Maghrebail 15 dirhams to 518 dirhams while Eqdom Credit advanced 31 dirhams to 1,091 dirhams.
First tranche of privatisation bonds, issued in January 1996, gained 12 dirhams to 1,367 dirhams.
ONA group, the biggest Moroccan private conglomerate, dropped five dirhams to 820 dirhams with 3,765 shares exchanged, the bourse said.
SNI, Societe Nationale d'Investissement, the second largest private group, fell eight dirhams to 742 dirhams.
In the banking sector, Wafabank dropped 25 dirhams to 820 dirhams. Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur closed unchanged at 580 dirhams.
In the energy sector, Samir was unchanged at 354 dirhams. Mining firm Societe Metallurgique d'Imiter dipped seven dirhams to 569 dirhams.
Total traded volume on the official market was 37.7 million dirhams from 25.9 million dirhams.
On the over-the-counter market, the volume was 16.8 million dirhams from 13 million dirhams. Main trade was in credit firm Maghrebail with more than 8,000 shares exchanged followed by 2,000 BMCE.
